scholarly_limits: Texier quoted by Kalinka reports eight TL55 lines; nine printed entry groups and nine frozen rows do not erase that historical statement. Full text/boundary collation, canonical reading acceptance and physical-line certification remain open.

The first documentary pass covers nine revised lines and 74 apparatus entries. Source label correspondence is not full row equivalence. The independent packet remains PREPARED_NOT_REVIEWED, with no reviewer or accepted readings.
Attribution review inspects pinned native packets, not underlying sources afresh. Its cases and apparatus notes are not independent witnesses or an alternative-pair total.

The encoded-sign comparison is exhaustive position accounting with candidate alignments;36 ambiguous records and152 pending triage items are not independently verified disagreements. Source PDF replay reproduces the encoding/alignment method, not epigraphic acceptance. No unit counts may be pooled into physical objects, ancient signs or independent witnesses.

Documentary follow-up covers every flagged TL55 candidate;19 ambiguity records have positional explanations,2 repeated-run and15 range-only dispositions. Original algorithm flags and pending external adjudication remain unchanged. Completion does not confer independent scientific acceptance.
snapshot_commit_scope: Mixed inputs retain their per-artifact anchors. New original review artifacts are byte-pinned and identified by published repository history, not assigned to an earlier commit.
